text:
[Council File 15-0989-S68]

COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER AND THE CHIEF LEGISLATIVE ANALYST relative to audit provision language for the Enhanced City Resources Master Agreement for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. (Ad Hoc Committee on the 2028 Olympics and Paralympic Games report to be submitted in Council. If public hearing is not held in Committee, an opportunity for public comment will be provided.)
(Please visit lms.lacity.gov for background documents.)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
